fixturePolicy: Fake devices, abstract resources and simulator state only; no physical actuation.

cases.requirement: Transport acceptance is distinct from independently observed mission completion.
cases.enforcement: Adapter state reducer and mission postcondition.

falsifier.must: Remain accepted or executing; never report completed.

cases.positiveControl: Fresh matching fake telemetry satisfying the mission postcondition produces observed completion.
cases.tradeoff: An adapter must expose outcome evidence beyond request transport.

cases.requirement: Idempotency binds actor, device epoch, request ID, workflow revision and payload hash durably.

falsifier.when: Reuse q1 with a different payload.
falsifier.must: Reject the conflicting request rather than replaying a cached success.

cases.positiveControl: The same identity and payload after a process restart returns the recorded outcome without duplicating an effect.
cases.tradeoff: Persistent deduplication needs retention policy and canonical payload hashing.

cases.requirement: Completion evidence must match the current device epoch, command and plan revision and satisfy the configured freshness bound.
cases.positiveControl: Current-epoch telemetry within the supplied age limit is eligible for postcondition evaluation.
cases.tradeoff: Clock and epoch semantics must be explicit across devices.

cases.requirement: Timeout after possible acceptance produces an unknown effect until reconciliation.
cases.enforcement: Command supervisor and adapter status query.

falsifier.must: Query the prior command outcome before any bounded retry.

cases.positiveControl: A proven rejection before acceptance can be retried according to the declared budget.
cases.tradeoff: Reconciliation may block progress during an outage.

cases.requirement: Retry count and overall recovery duration are bounded across nested control structures.
cases.enforcement: Global scheduler budget and adapter retry policy.

falsifier.when: Execute inside a loop and map combination.
falsifier.must: Stop attempts at the declared shared limit and preserve a non-success terminal reason.

cases.positiveControl: Availability restored within the budget permits the same command identity to continue.
cases.tradeoff: Global accounting can reduce parallel throughput but makes limits meaningful.

cases.requirement: Cancellation, interruption, kill and emergency stop have separate ownership and acknowledgement contracts.
cases.enforcement: Task state machine and verified deployment adapter.

falsifier.must: Block conflicting control until the required interruption or safe-state acknowledgement exists.

cases.positiveControl: An acknowledged interruption and valid lease transfer permit the replacement controller.
cases.tradeoff: Stopping semantics depend on device capabilities and cannot be synthesized from a generic prompt.

cases.requirement: Resource ownership is exclusive across independent agents and persists through relevant recovery transitions.

falsifier.when: Both actors request the resource concurrently.
falsifier.must: Grant at most one active lease; the other remains queued or rejected.

cases.positiveControl: After confirmed release, the waiting actor can acquire a new lease.
cases.tradeoff: Lease expiry alone may not establish that an old physical controller stopped.

cases.requirement: Map or workflow changes invalidate affected plans, approvals and completion evidence.

falsifier.must: Replan and obtain required revision-bound authorization before dispatch.

cases.positiveControl: An unchanged plan with fresh state and valid authorization can resume.
cases.tradeoff: Edits require impact analysis rather than immediate mutation of live commands.

cases.requirement: A schema-valid state without successful terminal evidence does not satisfy a mission.

falsifier.when: Evaluate a structurally acceptable task-state document.
falsifier.must: Report unknown or incomplete because the mission postcondition is absent.

cases.positiveControl: A completed state plus matching postcondition evidence satisfies the declared mission.
cases.tradeoff: Semantic validators are task-specific and cannot be replaced by JSON schema alone.

cases.requirement: SDK health, queued telemetry and an operator notification are not interchangeable with robot outcome or intervention resolution.
cases.enforcement: Adapter result typing and handoff state.

falsifier.must: Keep the intervention pending and the mission unresolved.

cases.positiveControl: A matching authorized operator acknowledgement permits the declared recovery action.
cases.tradeoff: An interface needs multiple typed outcomes instead of a generic success flag.

cases.requirement: Simulation success and software snapshots do not imply physical deployment readiness or physical rollback.

falsifier.must: Reject promotion until deployment-specific authority and evidence are supplied.

cases.positiveControl: The same workflow remains usable with its verified simulator adapter.
cases.tradeoff: Deployment qualification remains a separate engineering task.

cases.requirement: The visual inspector and executor identify the same immutable workflow revision and event position.

falsifier.when: An operator submits a change based on the displayed graph.
falsifier.must: Reject the stale proposal or require reconciliation against r2.

cases.positiveControl: A proposal against the current revision can be validated and applied under its authority rules.
cases.tradeoff: Clients must handle stale views explicitly.
